messages.content: For a solo upscale stay, the Loop and River North offer great safety and community vibes with plenty of transit access. You should generally avoid dark side streets in busier areas like the West Loop around 2 AM. Trust your instincts if a street doesn't feel right, and simply staying in well-lit, populated districts usually helps. Enjoy your trip and feel free to ask for specific dining recommendations once you're there!

The assistant responds by recommending the Loop and River North and advising the user to avoid dark side streets in the West Loop late at night, offering general safety tips.
